title: DASH age/insulin level esthetic bug
body:
@Andries-Smit You have simplified the information shown for EROS/DASH pods. Thanks :)

There is a small error on the interface (DASH in my case).

![20220202_172804.jpg](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/152523635-42575b31-63c5-4ed6-a209-b43cf3ba5f81.jpg)

You have _Age:Insulin level_ when _Age:_ should be removed.

It would be nice to eliminate all information concerning the battery for DASH. The battery changes with each pod. 

![Screenshot_20220202-171940_AndroidAPS.jpg](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/152524013-89d93697-f46a-4fdb-8b76-140934bacf76.jpg)
![Screenshot_20220202-171923_AndroidAPS.jpg](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/152524034-0b98ff02-77b0-43f6-a75e-9fc2ff3361d5.jpg)

The battery information for EROS should stay as it reports OL battery info.

comments.body: Thanks a lot :) Do we close this issue then ?
It would be great if you can test the fix and comment in the PR, if the new feature is good and if it solves your issues then you can close this issue.
